title: Water companies in England and Wales explore ‘surge pricing’ during drought

paragraphs.en: Water companies could be allowed to raise bills for customers during periods of drought under proposals being considered by the sector’s regulator for England and Wales.
paragraphs.zh: 根据英格兰和威尔士水务行业监管机构正在审议的提议，水务公司可能被允许在干旱期间提高向客户收取的水费。

paragraphs.en: Suppliers would be permitted to factor “water scarcity” into bills as part of efforts to reduce consumption under Ofwat’s plans, which are being likened to surge pricing – the practice where private hire firms raise taxi fares at times of higher demand.
paragraphs.zh: 按照Ofwat的计划，在减少用水量的努力中，供水公司将被允许把“水资源稀缺”因素纳入水费考量。这些计划被比作高峰定价——即私人租车公司在需求旺盛时提高车费的做法。

paragraphs.en: The proposals come just a few days after the prime minster, Andy Burnham, said he was angry with water companies and accused them of treating their customers like a “blank cheque” after more than a dozen firms were given the green light to raise water bills even higher.
paragraphs.zh: 这些提议出炉仅几天前，首相安迪·伯纳姆表示他对水务公司感到愤怒，指责它们把客户当作“空白支票”，此前十几家公司获准进一步提高水费。

paragraphs.en: It emerged last Thursday that five companies – Southern Water, Thames Water, Severn Trent, Wessex Water and South East Water – would be allowed to raise bills more than originally planned before the end of the decade to allow for billions of pounds of extra spending on repairs and infrastructure.
paragraphs.zh: 上周四曝出，南方水务（Southern Water）、泰晤士水务（Thames Water）、塞文特伦特水务（Severn Trent）、韦塞克斯水务（Wessex Water）和东南水务（South East Water）五家公司将被允许在本十年结束前将水费提高到超出原计划的水平，以弥补数十亿英镑的额外维修和基础设施支出。

paragraphs.en: The surge pricing proposals, first reported by the Sunday Telegraph, come after the 30 July conclusion of Ofwat’s consultation on changing the rules relating to wholesale charging, with the regulator due to share its final decision shortly.
paragraphs.zh: 这些高峰定价提议由《星期日电讯报》率先报道，是在Ofwat于7月30日结束关于修改批发收费规则的咨询之后提出的，该监管机构不久将公布其最终决定。

paragraphs.en: Public anger over the behaviour of water companies has soared in recent years as bills have continued to climb even while sewage has flowed into the nation’s waterways and firms have increased bosses’ pay and handed out millions of pounds in dividends to shareholders.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，公众对水务公司行为的愤怒急剧上升：水费持续上涨，与此同时污水不断流入全国水道，公司还提高老板薪酬，并向股东发放数百万英镑的股息。

paragraphs.en: During an exceptionally hot and dry summer, leading to almost three-quarters of England and all of Wales being declared officially in drought , suppliers have also come under fire for failing to save water lost through leaky pipes, which campaigners say far outstrips the amount that could be saved through a nationwide hosepipe ban.
paragraphs.zh: 在异常炎热干燥的夏季，英格兰近四分之三地区和威尔士全境被正式宣布为干旱状态，供水公司还因未能节省因管道泄漏而流失的水而受到抨击。活动人士称，这部分流失的水量远远超过在全国实施水管禁令所能节省的水量。

paragraphs.en: An Ofwat spokesperson said: “The efficient use of water is in the best interests of everyone, including businesses. The options we are progressing would support greater consideration of water scarcity and efficiency by water companies when setting their charges, and encourage more tariff innovation.”
paragraphs.zh: Ofwat的一位发言人表示：“高效用水符合包括企业在内所有人的最佳利益。我们正在推进的方案，将支持水务公司在制定收费时更充分地考虑水资源稀缺和用水效率，并鼓励更多的水费结构创新。”
